rm(list=ls())

df <- read.delim("/Users/aniketsharma/Documents/Research Assistant/Ethoscope/Analysis scripts/analysis_output/all_ethoscopes_merged_06APR.txt", header = T)



datSortBin <- function (input, n.days, cat.names = c("Control", "Experimental"), ethoscope.id, mins.trim) {
  library(stringr)
  
  dat <- list()
  
  for.df <- list()
  
  # Basic validation early (helps catch silent failures)
  stopifnot(is.data.frame(input))
  required_cols <- c("id", "t", "max_velocity")
  missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, colnames(input))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    stop("Input is missing required columns: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
  }
  if (length(ethoscope.id) != length(cat.names)) {
    stop("Length mismatch: ethoscope.id (", length(ethoscope.id),
         ") must match cat.names (", length(cat.names), ")")
  }
  if (length(ethoscope.id) != length(mins.trim)) {
    stop("Length mismatch: ethoscope.id (", length(ethoscope.id),
         ") must match mins.trim (", length(mins.trim), ")")
  }

  for (i in seq_along(ethoscope.id)) {
    txt <- ethoscope.id[i]
    for.df[[i]] <- input[str_detect(string = input$id, pattern = txt, negate = FALSE), ]
  }
  
  for (i in seq_along(for.df)) {
    df <- for.df[[i]]

    # If this ethoscope pattern matched nothing, skip cleanly
    if (nrow(df) == 0) {
      warning(paste0("No rows matched ethoscope.id='", ethoscope.id[i],
                     "'. Check the pattern or merged file. Skipping: ", cat.names[i]))
      next
    }
    
    t = as.data.frame(table(df$id))
    tt = subset(t, Freq != 0)
    etho.names <- as.vector(tt[,1])

    # If we still have no individuals, skip cleanly
    if (length(etho.names) == 0) {
      warning(paste0("No individuals found for ethoscope.id='", ethoscope.id[i],
                     "'. Skipping: ", cat.names[i]))
      next
    }
    
    n.time = n.days*((24*60*60)/10)
    # output.bin = 10/60
    
    ethoscope <- list()
    
    for (j in seq_along(etho.names)) {
      ethoscope[[j]] <- subset(df, id == etho.names[j], select = c("t","max_velocity"))
    }
    
    
    dat.etho <- matrix(NA, nrow = 1440*6*(n.days+10), ncol = length(ethoscope))
    
    for (ii in seq_along(ethoscope)) {
      rows_to_trim <- mins.trim[i] * 6
      if (rows_to_trim >= nrow(ethoscope[[ii]])) {
        warning(paste("Skipping individual", ii, "- not enough data after trimming"))
        next
      }
      trimmed.dat <- ethoscope[[ii]][-c(1:rows_to_trim),]
      dat.etho[1:nrow(trimmed.dat), ii] <- trimmed.dat[,"max_velocity"]
    }
    
    eth.names <- strsplit(etho.names, split = "|", fixed = T)
  
  col.names.etho <- c()
  for (kk in seq_along(dat.etho[1, ])) {
    # Some id strings may not contain a '|' delimiter; fall back safely
    idx <- if (length(eth.names[[kk]]) >= 2) eth.names[[kk]][2] else etho.names[kk]
    col.names.etho[kk] <- paste("Ind", idx, sep = "")
  }
  
  colnames(dat.etho) <- col.names.etho
  
  out.time <- as.matrix(seq(10, (length(dat.etho[,1])*10), by = 10))
  colnames(out.time) <- c("Time since start (sec)")
    
  dat[[i]] <- cbind(out.time, dat.etho)
    
  }
  names(dat) <- cat.names
  return(dat)
  
  
}

df.sorted <- datSortBin(input = df, n.days = 6, cat.names = c("Eth007", "Eth008", "Eth009", "Eth010", "Eth011", "Eth012", "Eth014", "Eth015"),
  ethoscope.id = c("007487", "0082e5", "0094b4", "01094c", "011082", "012a5d", "01428f", "015334"),
  mins.trim = c(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
)

saveRDS(df.sorted, "/Users/aniketsharma/Documents/Research Assistant/Ethoscope/Analysis scripts/analysis_output/all_ethoscopes_merged_06APR_10sec.rds")
